<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/** Cup progress belongs to the first unfinished generated round; league progress spans its whole fixture. */
function ygo_event_progress(array $rounds, bool $perRound): array
{
    usort($rounds,static fn($a,$b)=>(int)$a['round_number']<=>(int)$b['round_number']);
    $done=0;$total=0;$round=null;
    if($perRound&&$rounds){
        $current=end($rounds);
        foreach($rounds as $row)if((int)$row['done']<(int)$row['total']){$current=$row;break;}
        $done=(int)$current['done'];$total=(int)$current['total'];$round=(int)$current['round_number'];
    }else foreach($rounds as $row){$done+=(int)$row['done'];$total+=(int)$row['total'];}
    return ['done'=>$done,'total'=>$total,'round'=>$round,'ratio'=>$total>0?$done/$total:0];
}

function ygo_event_progress_groups(PDO $pdo): array
{
    $groups=[];
    $rows=$pdo->query("SELECT competition_id,round_number,COUNT(*) AS total,SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(status)) IN ('FINALIZADA','FINALIZADO','COMPLETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done FROM sx_ygo_matches WHERE competition_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY competition_id,round_number")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    foreach($rows as $row)$groups[(int)$row['competition_id']][]=$row;
    return $groups;
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/** Capture sporting identity when the roster is fixed, never infer it on a later read. */
function ygo_participant_identities(PDO $p,array $ids,string $format): array {
    if(!$ids)return [];
    $q=$p->prepare('SELECT id,team_id FROM sx_ygo_decks WHERE active=1 AND id IN ('.implode(',',array_fill(0,count($ids),'?')).')');$q->execute($ids);$out=[];
    foreach($q->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) as $d)$out[(int)$d['id']]=['deck_id'=>(int)$d['id'],'team_id'=>(int)($d['team_id']??0),'format_id'=>$format,'quality'=>'CONFIRMED_AT_ROSTER_FREEZE'];
    if(count($out)!==count($ids))throw new InvalidArgumentException('No se pudo fijar la identidad de todos los participantes.');
    return $out;
}

declare(strict_types=1);

function ygo_event_audit_snapshot(PDO $pdo, int $id): array
{
    $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM sx_ygo_competitions WHERE id=?');$q->execute([$id]);
    $event=$q->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)?:[];
    $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT id,name,promotion_slots,relegation_slots,promotion_to_division_id,relegation_to_division_id FROM sx_ygo_divisions WHERE league_competition_id=? AND active=1 ORDER BY tier_order,id');$q->execute([$id]);$event['divisions']=$q->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT depends_on_competition_id,condition_type,take_count FROM sx_ygo_competition_dependencies WHERE competition_id=? AND active=1 ORDER BY id');$q->execute([$id]);$event['dependencies']=$q->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT deck_id FROM sx_ygo_competition_decks WHERE competition_id=? AND active=1 ORDER BY sort_order,id');$q->execute([$id]);
    return ['event'=>$event,'participants'=>array_map('intval',$q->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN))];
}

/** Query the persisted event history, independently of the global dashboard limit. */
function ygo_event_audit_page(PDO $pdo, int $id, int $before=0, string $search=''): array
{
    $q=$pdo->prepare('SELECT id,name FROM sx_ygo_competitions WHERE id=?');$q->execute([$id]);$event=$q->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    if(!$event)throw new InvalidArgumentException('El evento no existe.');
    $where="entity_type='competition' AND entity_id=?";$args=[$id];
    if($before>0){$where.=' AND id<?';$args[]=$before;}
    $search=mb_substr(trim($search),0,150);
    if($search!==''){$where.=" AND (action LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' OR payload LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' OR created_at LIKE ? ESCAPE '!')";$term='%'.strtr($search,['!'=>'!!','%'=>'!%','_'=>'!_']).'%';array_push($args,$term,$term,$term);}
    $q=$pdo->prepare("SELECT id,action,payload,created_at FROM sx_ygo_audit_log WHERE $where ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 26");$q->execute($args);$rows=$q->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);$more=count($rows)>25;$rows=array_slice($rows,0,25);
    foreach($rows as &$row){$row['label']=ygo_audit_label((string)$row['action']);$row['detail']=json_decode((string)$row['payload'],true)??['detalle'=>(string)$row['payload']];unset($row['payload']);}unset($row);
    return ['ok'=>true,'event'=>$event,'rows'=>$rows,'next_cursor'=>$more?(int)end($rows)['id']:null];
}

function ygo_event_audit_api(PDO $pdo): never
{
    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');header('Cache-Control: no-store');
    try{
        if($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']!=='GET'){http_response_code(405);header('Allow: GET');throw new InvalidArgumentException('Este historial solo permite consulta.');}
        if(!ygo_can_edit()){http_response_code(403);throw new InvalidArgumentException('No tienes permiso para consultar la auditoría.');}
        echo json_encode(ygo_event_audit_page($pdo,(int)($_GET['event_id']??0),max(0,(int)($_GET['before']??0)),(string)($_GET['search']??'')),JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    }catch(Throwable $e){if(http_response_code()<400)http_response_code(422);echo json_encode(['ok'=>false,'message'=>$e->getMessage()],JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);}
    exit;
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/** Presentation only: never rename stored events, division keys or form values. */
function ygo_ui_event_name(string $name): string {
    if(preg_match('/^(.+?)\s+League$/iu',trim($name),$m))return 'Liga '.$m[1];
    return preg_replace('/\binaguracion temporada\b/iu','inauguración de temporada',$name)??$name;
}

function ygo_ui_labels_catalog(array $divisions,array $competitions): array {
    $out=['events'=>[],'events_by_id'=>[],'divisions'=>[],'division_short'=>[],'cups'=>[]];
    foreach($competitions as $event){
        $label=ygo_ui_event_name((string)$event['name']);
        $out['events'][$event['name']]=$label;
        $out['events_by_id'][(string)$event['id']]=['name'=>$label,'type'=>$event['type']];
        if($event['type']==='cup')$out['cups'][]=$label;
    }
    $ordinals=['Primera','Segunda','Tercera','Cuarta','Quinta','Sexta','Séptima','Octava','Novena','Décima'];
    foreach($divisions as $code=>$division){
        $owner=(string)($division['league_competition_id']??'');$event=$out['events_by_id'][$owner]??null;
        $short=(string)($division['name']??$division['short']??$code);
        if($event&&$event['type']==='league'){
            $own=array_values(array_filter($divisions,fn($d)=>(string)($d['league_competition_id']??'')===$owner));
            usort($own,fn($a,$b)=>[(int)($a['tier_order']??0),(int)$a['id']]<=>[(int)($b['tier_order']??0),(int)$b['id']]);
            $index=array_search((int)$division['id'],array_map(fn($d)=>(int)$d['id'],$own),true);
            $short=count($own)===1?'División Única':(isset($ordinals[$index])?$ordinals[$index].' División':'División '.($index+1));
            $full=$event['name'].' — '.$short;
        }else $full=$short;
        $out['divisions'][(string)$code]=$full;$out['division_short'][(string)$code]=$short;
    }
    return $out;
}

function ygo_ui_match_label(array $match,string $code,mixed $round,array $labels): string {
    $event=$labels['events_by_id'][(string)($match['competition_id']??'')]??null;
    $name=$event&&$event['type']==='league'?($labels['divisions'][$code]??$event['name']):($event['name']??$labels['divisions'][$code]??'Evento');
    return $name.' — Ronda '.$round.' — Mesa '.($match['mesa']??'-');
}

function ygo_ui_labels_script(array $labels): string {
    return '<script>window.StationXPresentationCatalog='.json_encode($labels,JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_HEX_TAG|JSON_HEX_AMP|JSON_HEX_APOS|JSON_HEX_QUOT).';</script><script src="./assets/ui-labels.js?v=20261026-labels-101" defer></script>';
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/** Structural invariants for new recipes; historical fixtures are never migrated here. */
function ygo_event_contract_errors(array $c,?array $preset=null): array {
    $e=[];$model=(string)($c['execution_model']??'manual');$phase=$c['phase_structure']??'';$advance=$c['advancement_rule']??'';
    $code=$c['prompt_template']??$c['code']??'';$base=function_exists('ygo_template_base_code')?ygo_template_base_code($code):$code;
    if($model==='free_for_all'&&(($c['match_format']??'ffa')!=='ffa'||($c['best_of']??1)!=1||$advance!=='WINNER_ONLY'))$e[]='Free-for-All requiere mesa independiente, un duelo y ultimo superviviente ganador.';
    if(!in_array($advance,['FINAL_STANDINGS','SOURCE_ADMISSION','MANUAL_ENTRIES','TOP_N','GROUP_TOP_K','WINNER_ONLY'],true))$e[]='El criterio de avance es ambiguo o pertenece a Fuentes y clasificados del evento destino. Selecciona un contrato explicito para esta receta.';
    if(in_array($model,['swiss','round_robin','double_round_robin','league_points','groups','ladder'],true)&&!in_array($advance,['FINAL_STANDINGS','SOURCE_ADMISSION'],true))$e[]='Un sistema de tabla sin fase final no ejecuta un corte interno. Elige Tabla final o plazas en el evento destino.';
    if($model==='manual'&&$advance!=='MANUAL_ENTRIES')$e[]='El sistema manual requiere seleccion de participantes de entrada; no genera avances automaticos.';
    if($model==='groups_knockout'&&$advance!=='GROUP_TOP_K')$e[]='Grupos con llave requiere cupos por grupo y avance por ganador despues del corte.';
    if(in_array($model,['swiss_top_cut','season_playoffs'],true)&&$advance!=='TOP_N')$e[]='El sistema compuesto requiere un corte Top N antes de su llave.';
    if(in_array($model,['single_elimination','bracket','double_elimination','top_cut','playoffs','series','king_of_the_hill','gauntlet','flights'],true)&&$advance!=='WINNER_ONLY')$e[]='Este sistema avanza por ganador; las plazas de entrada se configuran aparte.';
    if($preset!==null){
        $expected=$preset['execution_model'];$allowed=$preset['allowed_execution_models']??[$expected];
        if(in_array($expected,['round_robin','double_round_robin','league_points'],true))$allowed=['round_robin','double_round_robin','league_points'];
        if(!in_array($model,$allowed,true))$e[]='La plantilla '.$preset['label'].' requiere '.$expected.'. Elige otra plantilla o Personalizado para cambiar su estructura.';
        if(($c['type']??null)!==($preset['type']??null))$e[]='El tipo de evento no corresponde a la plantilla elegida.';
        if(isset($c['match_format']) && in_array($base,['team_ycs','ots_tournament_series','team_3v3','team_league','team_cup','team_championship','tag_duel'],true) && $c['match_format']!==$preset['match_format'])$e[]='La participacion debe coincidir con el contrato de equipos de la plantilla.';
        if(in_array($code,['best_of_1_event','best_of_3_event'],true) && (int)($c['best_of']??0)!==($code==='best_of_1_event'?1:3))$e[]='El mejor de no coincide con la plantilla.';
    }
    if($code==='clasificatorio_divisiones_3_duelos' && $model!=='swiss')$e[]='El clasificatorio de tres enfrentamientos usa Suizo sin Top Cut interno. Para una final elige Suizo + Top Cut.';
    $phases=['swiss_top_cut'=>['TOP_CUT','GROUPS_TOP_CUT_FINAL'],'groups_knockout'=>['GROUPS_TOP_CUT_FINAL'],
        'season_playoffs'=>['SEASON_PLAYOFF_FINAL'],'groups'=>['GROUPS'],'series'=>['FINAL','GRAND_FINAL']];
    if(isset($phases[$model]) && !in_array($phase,$phases[$model],true))$e[]='Las fases no representan el sistema competitivo elegido.';
    if($model==='swiss' && in_array($phase,['TOP_CUT','GROUPS_TOP_CUT_FINAL','SEASON_PLAYOFF_FINAL'],true))$e[]='Suizo simple no genera una fase final. Selecciona una receta compuesta.';
    if(in_array($model,['single_elimination','bracket','double_elimination','top_cut','playoffs'],true) && !in_array($advance,['WINNER_ONLY','TOP_N'],true))$e[]='Una eliminatoria requiere avance por ganador, no seleccion manual ni umbral de puntos.';
    if(in_array($model,['top_cut','playoffs'],true) && ($c['participant_source']??'')!=='PREVIOUS_EVENT')$e[]='Top Cut y Playoffs aislados requieren una fuente de clasificados verificable.';
    if($base==='pegasus_challenge'){
        if(!in_array($model,['swiss','single_elimination','round_robin','double_round_robin','league_points'],true)||($c['match_format']??'1v1')!=='1v1')$e[]='Pegasus requiere modalidad individual y Suizo, eliminacion directa o liga.';
        if(!in_array($c['event_ruleset']??'tcg_advanced',['tcg_advanced','tcg_traditional'],true))$e[]='Pegasus usa TCG Avanzado o Tradicional.';
    }
    return array_values(array_unique($e));
}
